observation: Builder src/render/characters/rubricModel.js, dispatched by visualFactory.js:7970 for rubricPart body|mark (hull stays an ordinary wreck by design). Body: a per-instance finish set (46-67) feeds mergeStatic (88-108), which buckets direct static children by material uuid + castShadow, strips non position/normal/uv attributes, disposes source geometry and emits one mesh per bucket. Deliberate preserved exceptions: animated wheel, liquid, lamp and hover ring groups; instanced spray droplets (skipped at 91 and kept as InstancedMesh); arm segments where foreLink/foreStripe stay unmerged because IK scales them per frame; per-mark materials because each paint mark owns its own wear/opacity state. The ghost smear recently moved from a strike.clone() per ghost entry to one owned smearMaterial shared by every ghost bar (441-443), so a dashed smear no longer costs one material per dash while all segments still follow the same opacity. The skins atlas is cloned per instance and explicitly disposed via disposeSkins (283-289), so the cloned texture is not leaked. Budget guarded by test/rubric-model.test.mjs (meshes<=140, tris<14000, marker draw budget <=60, smear segments share one material).
decision: Keep. No construction change recommended; the batching, instancing, IK exception and merged-smear material are all intentional and guarded by tests. Recommend needs follow-up until current captures exist.
